abilities.name: Barbed Sling
abilities.description: A slung burst of barbs that detonates where it lands — lobbed over walls, 15 damage in the blast, and the barbs left behind are an 8-damage mine on that square for 2 turns. The zone kit pokes over the terrain it fights around.

abilities.name: Snare Bloom
abilities.description: FREE ACTION — costs no ability, so Thorn still slings this turn. Plants a hidden snare: 12 damage on entry, a Slow that lasts through the next turn, and whoever steps in stops dead on that square.

abilities.name: Bramble Stride
abilities.description: Thorn surges through the undergrowth up to 4 squares; the first unit crossed takes 10 damage and is Rooted for a turn. The escape that still leaves someone stuck to the floor.

abilities.name: Verdant Veil
abilities.description: Restorative spores heal allies in the aimed area for 20. Smaller than a Mender's heal — Thorn's defense budget is partly spent on control.

ultimate.name: Overgrowth
ultimate.description: The ground erupts: allies in the area heal 30; enemies are Rooted and Weakened for a turn. The board itself takes a side. (100 energy)
